{"score":0.86,"idealMarkdown":"# Vendor Shortlist for Office Wi-Fi Refresh

Before the Friday review, compare the candidate vendors, confirm current pricing, and save the latest product sheets.

- Check [Aster Networks](https://www.aster-networks.example/vendors) for updated reseller terms and download the [channel guide](https://www.aster-networks.example/docs/channel-guide.pdf).
- Review [North Pier Wireless](https://northpier.example/products/wifi) and note whether the [installation checklist](https://northpier.example/support/install-checklist) still matches our branch layout.
  - If North Pier is shortlisted, request a quote through the [partner portal](https://partners.northpier.example/login).
